Frequently asked questions

How long does carpet take to dry?

Usually 4–8 hours depending on the carpet and ventilation. We can schedule evening work so it is dry by morning.

Can you remove old stains?

Most stains come out with pre-treatment and extraction. Some old or dyed stains can be lightened but not always fully removed; we tell you honestly before we start.

How often should office carpet be deep cleaned?

We recommend every 3–6 months for busy offices, with spot cleaning in between.
